## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete issue and what this change makes the app do.

## Validation

List relevant commands and results. For UI changes, include a native screenshot
and tested scaling/window sizes. Separate mocked/layout checks from live behavior.

## Risks and limits

Describe any process/file/startup/power mutations, compatibility limits or remaining checks.

## Review

- [ ] Scope is focused and documentation matches the implementation.
- [ ] No credentials, settings, recovery data, private logs or build fixtures are included.
- [ ] Resource/performance claims include conditions and evidence.
